description: one toilet, one sink, a full-length mirror propped crooked against the wall instead of mounted. the trash bin holds a small graveyard of crumpled napkins. graffiti on the dryer offers a hotline number corrected twice in different pens.

items.description: two stalls with full doors and functioning latches, a minor miracle of franchise engineering. on the inner wall of the second, in neat handwriting, a note reads 'whoever keeps leaving the tray by the nacho bar — stop.'
items.name: stalls

items.description: a white laminate counter with two sinks and a mirror stained at the edges. a paper towel mound sits in the corner where the third dispenser once lived.
items.name: sink counter

items.description: a fold-down changing table bolted to the wall, sticky top surface and a strap that has lost its buckle. it folds up with a stubborn *schuck* it has no right to make.
items.name: changing table

name: Taco Bell Women's Restroom

exits.description: same beige door, same chipped paint, opposite stick figure. the lock is one of those twist knobs that never fully believes it's locked.
